text: May heat. Seven in the morning. Everything was absolutely fine...
Cold, cold water... hot, hot me! La-la-la!
Arey? Did the rain stop?
Water... water! Soap in my eye! Poojaaa!
Mummyji, no water here either! Only air!
The tap is unwell. Not fever, thirst.
Did you hear? My tap is coughing!
One drop? I paid the whole month's bill!
Evil eye! The tap got the evil eye!
Science says... the tap is sleeping.
We're live! Whole colony is dry!
Who shut the water? I fear nobody!
And then... the whole colony's water, gone!
Tanker's here! Tanker's here!
Make way! Soap man coming!
My bucket! Imported! Not one rupee less!
Let's go, let's go! We'll bring drums full!
One metre. Record.
One house, two buckets! Don't push, yaar!
Enough! Now I'll handle it.
Seth ji, this is a bucket?
The bucket's big brother!
Seth ji! The whole colony is watching!
I'm hungry... and thirsty too.
Finished! Next tanker, afternoon na.
Did you hear? Next tanker, three days later!
Hello Sharma ji, did you hear? Verma ji, did you hear?
Pigeon ji... did you hear?
Three days? Oh God... all gone in three hours!
Three hours? No... three minutes! Run!
In three minutes, the afternoon tanker became three days.
Bottle, twenty! Hurry, rate is going up!
Forty! Rate is like weather, keeps changing.
Twelve bottles! One to bathe, eleven to bathe again!
How much for one bottle?
Hundred!
Then leave it. Air is free.
Don't take tension! Give me all bottles, I'll sell at double!
I'm selling at triple myself.
Seth ji!
Twenty... it was only twenty!
We're live! Water, costlier than gold!
Twelve bottles of water! I'll bathe like a king today!
Not a king. A commoner. One mug.
Half a mug? For this much soap?
In our days, half a mug bathed a whole wedding party!
Fine! I fear nobody! Half a mug, let's go!
Wait! Whatever water spills goes to the tulsi.
Papa, the soap drank all the water!
Second mug? The whole colony will watch!
Chhee... lizard!
I'm not scared... just worried about its thirst.
Mummyji, the tank was full last night.
Then where did it go by morning?
I have an idea! Water detectives!
Detective team, ready?
Shh! Detectives don't talk.
Shall I tell? Follow the water... find the thief!
One!
Two!
This dripping tap... is the sweetest!
Fourteen taps are dripping! Fourteen!
And this river of water... where does it go?
Tinku Car Wash! Car, scooter, buffalo... all washed!
Stop! Close the pipe!
Close? It's business! Water free, full profit!
Shall I tell? This pipe is running since five a.m.
That's why our tank is empty!
Don't take tension! Water isn't mine, it's the colony's!
That's exactly why there's tension!
Inquiry! Who is it?
Science says... air plus water equals rain!
Quiet! Let's see.
We're live! Colony's first rain!
Science says... rain falls only on scientists.
Lakhan has bathed? I'm still in soap!
<laugh> The whole colony is watching... Lakhan's bath!
One more bucket gone. Fifteenth tap!
Just... a little calibration left.
Did you hear? Last tanker!
And so began... the colony's biggest bucket race!
This time, first bucket is mine!
Let's go!
Arey... today also?
Will somebody tell me... where am I?
Get out of my bucket!
It's not a bucket... it's the bucket's big brother!
There will be an inquiry! Stop! No, go! No, stop!
We're live! Bucket jam, one hundred metres long!
The whole colony is watching... and nobody is moving!
Pigeon ji, did you hear...? Arey!
Quiet!!!
Fighting for water... and taps are still dripping!
Shall I tell? Check the maths!
Silence! Today's class... water!
Shall I tell? One dripping tap, one drop every second.
Boondi? Where is the boondi?
Not boondi, boond! A drop!
One tap, one month... sixty buckets!
<gasp> Sixty? Oh God!
Fourteen times sixty... eight hundred forty buckets!
If I had sold that many bottles...
Seth ji!
And Tinku Uncle's pipe... fifty buckets an hour!
Tension... a little bit is happening.
Madam, line repair is going on only. Water will come by evening itself.
By evening? Not three days?
Who told three days, madam?
So the water never stopped... we ourselves flushed it away!
Fourteen taps, one pipe, one bathtub...
And one soapy papa!
Enough! Now we fix it.
Ten seconds.
Nine seconds! The whole colony is watching!
Piece of cake! I can do it with my left hand!
Aah... bathed! Finally!
Did you hear? Ramesh ji has bathed!
One bucket, one cloth... car is shining!
<laugh> Buffalo too! But with bucket!
Dripping water is mine too! Not one drop wasted!
Science says... fix the dripping tap.
Lakhan bhaiya... right for the first time!
Sweet tap... has retired.
Roof water, straight into the drum!
Now the rain won't get the evil eye.
We're live! Hashtag save every drop!
That day, fourteen taps got fixed... and one papa got a bath.
Evening came... and water returned to the taps.
From today, Ramesh Sharma... bathes in one bucket!
Half.
Little drops make the mighty ocean...
...and little drops can drain it too.
Fix the leaking tap today... not tomorrow.
And the sky's water... in the drum.
Car wash, by bucket!
No open pipes!
And rain water... on the roof!
Hooray, rain!
Free shower! God, switch it on!
